description:
Join to apply for the Mechanical Designer-Turbomachinery role at Air Products

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Mechanical Designer-Turbomachinery role at Air Products

At Air Products, our purpose is to bring people together to reimagine what’s possible, collaborate and innovate solutions to the world’s most significant energy and environmental sustainability challenges. Grow with us as we embark on building tomorrow together by being the safest, most diverse and most profitable industrial gas company in the world.
Reimagine What’s Possible
Are you looking for a dynamic, growth-oriented career working with extraordinary people with a mission to provide world-class products and customer service? Rotoflow , An Air Products Business, may be the place for you!
Rotoflow is a full-service turbomachinery OEM providing a comprehensive range of new equipment solutions and aftermarket services to our global customers. For over 75 years, Rotoflow has designed and manufactured both standard and custom-engineered cryogenic and warm gas centrifugal turbomachinery used in market segments such as industrial gases, petrochemicals, and hydrocarbons. Products include our wide-ranging proprietary turbo-expanders and related equipment consisting of new equipment designs, upgrades and repairs along with a full complement of supporting services. Our customers are served globally through regional service centers supported by both regional and centralized execution teams.
We are currently seeking a Mechanical Designer to join our team at our global headquarters in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania. This role involves minimal travel.
Do you have a passion for precision design, solving unique engineering challenges, and contributing to world-class machinery development? Rotoflow is looking for a Mechanical Designer who thrives in a collaborative environment and is excited to work on high-speed rotating machinery and support systems. If this sounds like you, come grow with us as we continue to build a sustainable tomorrow together.
Rotoflow Employees Enjoy

  • Being part of a world class engineering, manufacturing, and business organization developing machinery solutions for our customers,
  • Collaborating with a multi-functional team across sales, engineering, purchasing, and manufacturing on a wide variety of projects with varying technical complexity and scope,
  • Tapping into the wealth of technical experience available within Rotoflow and the opportunity to explore technical interests,
  • Being part of a team of highly motivated individuals,
  • Seeing projects come to life from concept through manufacturing and testing,
  • The ability to grow and develop one’s career and take on increasing responsibility.
Key Job Responsibilities
  • Responsible for equipment design and development, layout, detailed part drawing creation, BOM generation, manufacturing, purchasing and production support as necessary throughout projects,
  • Creation of 3D CAD models of turbomachinery components including complex geometries such as radial impellers,
  • Creation of 2D and 3D CAD layouts,
  • Creation of 2D drawings using geometric dimensioning,
  • Perform stack-up analysis of precision machinery,
  • Interface with a broad spectrum of suppliers and disposition part variations and deviations,
  • Create conceptual layouts to support new product development,
  • Perform quality and technical checks of drawings and documents as a checker,
  • Designing and creating manufacturing drawings for tooling associated with servicing turbomachinery,
  • Creation, revision, and maintenance of part numbers, part routings and bills of materials in Air Products’ ERP system (SAP),
  • The successful candidate will need to interact with colleagues including proposals, project management, engineering, shop operations, and field service engineers,
  • Promote safety and diversity consistent with the philosophies of Rotoflow.
Required Skills / Abilities
  • 2D and 3D CAD, simulation, and FEA experience a plus,
  • Working knowledge of ERP and MRP Systems a plus,
  • Knowledge of turbomachinery or other high speed rotating machinery a strong plus,
  • Time management skills and ability to work independently on multiple concurrent projects or tasks and as a team,
  • Strong knowledge Microsoft Office tools,
  • Attention to detail and written and oral communication skills,
  • Understanding of revision control philosophy,
  • Experience with tolerancing and stack-up philosophies,
  • Experience with design of assembly tooling,
  • Experience with SolidWorks and Bentley MicroStation or AutoCAD a strong plus,
  • Experience with SAP ERP system a strong plus.
Minimum Hiring Requirements
  • Associates Degree in Mechanical Design or equivalent. BS in a technical field a plus,
  • Minimum 3 years' experience in a mechanical design occupation. 10+ years' experience a plus,
  • Basic knowledge of ANSI GD&T.
Working Conditions And/or Benefits Of This Role
  • This is a full-time position based in Bethlehem, PA,
  • You will be expected to work on-site 5 days per week during initial training. There is potential to transition to a hybrid work schedule,
  • Minimal travel required,
  • Opportunity for career growth and increasing responsibility,
  • Be part of a motivated, technically skilled team,
  • See your designs come to life from concept through manufacturing and testing.
If you are dedicated and driven to achieve your objectives and company goals, have passion and commitment to get it right, have a never-ending desire to learn, improve, and contribute, then come discover, care, accomplish and thrive at Air Products!
To learn more, visit Air Products and Rotoflow.

As a veteran-friendly organization, we actively encourage and welcome veterans to apply for various roles within our company. We recognize the unique strengths and experiences that veterans contribute, and we foster a workplace that honors your service while providing a platform for professional growth.
We are the world’s largest hydrogen producer with over 80 years of industrial gas experience. We are hydrogen and industrial gas experts delivering safe, end-to-end solutions, investing in real, clean energy projects at scale, and driving the industry forward to generate a cleaner future.
At Air Products, we work in an environment where we put safety first, diversity is essential, inclusion is our culture, and each person knows they belong and matter. To learn more, visitAbout Air Products.

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.
Growth
We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.
Diversity and Inclusion
Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.
Diversity & Inclusion
Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non-negotiable value of who we are.
We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. description:
AB InBev is the global beer leader and one of the top 5 consumer goods companies in the world. With over 500 beer brands, we are number one or two in many of the world's key beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About the ABI Growth Group

Founded in 2022, the Growth Group unites our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global technology and commercial functions, the Growth Group enables us to make the most of data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev worldwide.

In addition to supporting globally recognized beer brands such as Corona, Budweiser, and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust set of digital products, including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and the PerfectDraft beer keg system.

We are an exceptional team focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, leveraging new technologies, and increasing growth opportunities.

Data Product Manager

The Data Product Manager of the Bees Personalization team is responsible for designing and developing all data products within their squad.

This position's mission is to organize, prioritize, and execute the activities in the backlog, aligned with stakeholder needs, while always maintaining a critical and proactive perspective. The role involves measuring the value generated by each activity and the development effort, conducting product impact analyses, and using them to solve problems.

The Data Product Manager is responsible for leading all squad ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, planning, retrospectives, reviews, and refinements (both technical and product-related), as well as organizing the sprint agendas.

The role also requires documentation of all features and product descriptions, explaining models in an intermediate language between academic and corporate documentation, so they are easily interpretable by the technical team (scientists and engineers) and business stakeholders. Knowledge of agile methodologies and CRISP-DM, along with management tools like Confluence and DevOps, is crucial for this role.

This position requires deep business knowledge, as well as a technical background that allows programming skills in key languages like SQL, PySpark, and Python. Additionally, knowledge of data science fundamentals is required, including the ability to code main models and algorithms, interpret and critique results, and propose the best modeling approaches in collaboration with data scientists.

Data engineering knowledge is essential to contribute to discussions with data engineers and a basic understanding of BI modeling. The squad has a global scope, covering all major BEES business units and partner industries. Each squad will consist of 11 to 17 members, with the product manager as the team leader. Strong soft skills such as clear communication, didactics, leadership (both vertical and horizontal), flexibility, teamwork, and experience working with multiple stakeholders are key for success.

What You’ll Do:

  • Take responsibility for leading teams as a Product Manager, ensuring successful delivery of features and services. Demonstrate ownership and responsibility for the product’s success.
  • Build strong partnerships with internal and external stakeholders, becoming the authority on feature launches, product roadmaps, and user pain points. Act as the voice of the customer, advocating for their needs and ensuring their satisfaction.
  • Collaborate effectively with teams such as engineering, design, product, data science, and commercial. Work closely with the Data team to leverage their expertise in driving data-informed decisions and insights.
  • Define success metrics for features or services and monitor performance.
  • Understand complex problems across business units, geographies, and product lines. Formulate hypotheses and translate them into requirements, identifying significant insights to guide product development.
  • Create roadmaps based on relevant requirements and dependencies. Ensure alignment with business and strategic goals.

What You Need:

  • Write detailed business requirements and user stories that serve as the basis for creating product specifications. Ensure clear communication and alignment with the development team.
  • Experience in managing an agile development process. Collaborate with development teams to ensure efficient and effective product delivery.
  • Use data and metrics to support assumptions, develop business cases, and drive improvements.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills to extract insights from data.
  • A desire to learn the processes, systems, and business functions needed to operate a world-class B2B sales operation. Continuously seek opportunities for growth and improvement.
  • Desired knowledge in SQL and Data Analysis.

More About You:

  • You are driven by building world-class solutions that impact millions of users globally.
  • Experience working in an environment that uses and encourages a DevOps culture.
  • You are creative in solving problems and continually seek improvements for processes and solutions.
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify problems and demands.
  • You have the autonomy to recognize current and new priorities, assessing the impact of your results on the final outcome.

Gostamos de trabalhar de um jeito descomplicado, e valorizamos o jeito simples de ser e agir. O nosso jeito é leve, parceiro e amigo. O que você irá fazer no seu dia a dia e com o que irá trabalhar?

Será incrível receber seu currículo e saber do seu interesse pelo nosso time! Nossas oportunidades são para pessoas talentosas, independente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, deficiência, classe social ou religião. Confira nossos benefícios!

  • Identificar e reportar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de rampa, seja de maneira micro e/ou macro, realizar briefings operacionais e comportamentais, promover reuniões, dar feedback;
  • Coordenar todas as atividades pertinentes à movimentação de equipamentos de rampa durante o descarregamento e carregamento de bagagens e cargas das aeronaves, orientando os colaboradores durante as operações quanto à logística de atividades, análises de sinistralidades e agindo frente a possíveis ocorrências a fim de evitar rupturas operacionais e perda de qualidade nos serviços executados.

  • Ensino Superior é um diferencial;
  • Visão analítica e sistemática, para tomadas de decisões;
  • Disponibilidade de horário;
  • Conhecimento intermediário no pacote office;
  • Conhecimento em processo de atendimento ao cliente;
  • Capacidade de liderança e gestão de pessoas.
Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura em bipedestação para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, locomoção e deambulação por toda extensão do aeroporto e para condução do veículo para transportes internos no pátio do aeroporto.
Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para condução de veículo a serviço da empresa (atividade regulamentada pelo CTB – código de trânsito brasileiro), suporte à equipe e acompanhamento das atividades operacionais, e percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico e aos colaboradores e detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais em áreas operacionais.
Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

title: Software-Defined Networking Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Software-Defined Networking Engineer role at Canonical

14 hours ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software-Defined Networking Engineer role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

This is a general selection process for all seniority levels, to join teams that focus on open source networking software at Canonical. Apply here if you are an outstanding software engineer, passionate about networking at any level - from the Linux kernel IP or eBPF and bridge constructs, to overlay SDN networking like OVS and OVN, to router, switch and radio access technologies such as SoNIC, FRR and DENT, all the way up to telco MANO and 5G Core solutions.
We work with networking silicon providers to optimise Ubuntu and related applications for their ASICs, boards and appliances. We aim to provide a complete open source stack for data centre networking, from bare metal through virt, container and serverless, and also to address IoT networking systematically.
If you have a passion for networking technologies, deep familiarity with Linux networking and awareness of open source community best practices, then you will enjoy our software-defined networking role at Canonical. We look for excellent academic results and a commitment to quality, resilience, documentation and performance in your work.
At Canonical you will have the opportunity to engage with the broader open-source community and industry leading partners in developing future-proof networking solutions. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community, contribute to a broad range of technologies, and contribute to the deployment of Ubuntu, Ubuntu Core, OpenStack, LXD, MAAS and MicroK8s across a broad range of devices and use cases.
These roles include:

  • Kernel Networking Software Engineer
  • OVN Software Engineer
  • SmartNIC Software Engineer
  • Top-of-Rack (ToR) Software Engineer
  • SoNIC or DENT Software Engineer
  • Telco Software Engineer
  • Kubernetes Software Engineer
Location: we have networking software engineering roles in every time zone
What your day will look like
  • Work with the most advanced operating systems and network application technologies available
  • Collaborate with public clouds and network silicon providers
  • Design and implement the best software-defined networking experience for the latest hardware platforms and software stacks
  • Write high-quality, well-designed and well-documented software
  • Contribute to shape innovative product strategies
  • Debug issues and produce high-quality code to fix them
  • Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed organisation
  • Contribute to technical documentation to make it the best of its kind
  • Display technical leadership internally, towards our partners, and in the open source communities
  • Influence open-source projects and communities
  • Shape software-define networking products for evolving data centre architectures to meet ever-increasing bandwidth, reliability, security, and interoperability demands
  • Work from home, with global travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks duration
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Knowledge of networking: architecture, design, and protocols
  • Deep understanding of Linux networking, from kernel to user space
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, C/C++, Rust or Python
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Familiarity with existing open source networking technologies - kernel (including eBPF, AF_XDP), OVS, OVN, SoNIC, DENT, Switchdev, DPDK, SPDK, 5G 3GPP, ONF stack, iwd, NetworkManager, etc.
  • Familiarity with data path hardware acceleration protocols and interfaces, such as RDMA, RoCE, iWARP, NVMe, SR-IOV
  • Computer architecture knowledge of x86, ARM, and RISC-V
  • Experience in complex IP network engineering and implementation
  • Experience with virtualization technologies, e.g., QEMU, KVM, etc.
  • Previous contribution to open source projects and community involvement
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, Cloud-native Network Functions, and Container Network Interface plugins
  • Performance engineering and security experience
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Senior Accident Reconstruction and/or Biomechanical Expert
description:
Senior Accident Reconstruction and/or Biomechanical Expert

Senior Accident Reconstruction and/or Biomechanical Expert

Job Title: Accident Reconstruction and/or Biomechanical Expert – Senior Level

Terms: Salary – Full Time

About us:

Paragon Forensics is a leading full-service consulting firm specialized in providing forensic analysis and expert opinion to the legal and insurance industries. Our principal services include analyses of accident reconstruction, premises liability, biomechanics, and safety to assist our clients in their evaluation of actual or potential injury-related claims. We are a multidisciplinary team of engineers and scientists who collaborate on cases in a relaxed yet fast-paced work environment.

Job Description:

The Senior Level Accident Reconstruction and/or Biomechanical Expert is expected to be a lead consultant on forensic cases pertaining to personal injury lawsuits or claims. This role will include responsibility for client/case acquisition, case management, review and analysis of file material, performance of inspections, and collaboration with support staff. As the lead consultant on cases, this position requires providing expert testimony through depositions, arbitration and trials, as well as writing reports and declarations. Additionally, this engineer will be responsible for the design, implementation, analysis, and publication of novel research relevant to the industry. This position may also involve supporting other cases which Paragon staff are working on. The Senior Level Expert is expected to assist in training and developing other Paragon staff.

Responsibilities:

The Senior Accident Reconstruction role includes, but is not limited to, analyses of motor vehicle incidents to assess questions regarding liability and impact severity, including cases involving heavy trucks, motorcycles, pedestrians, bicycles/scooters, etc. The engineer is expected to be well-versed in inspection of vehicles and incident sites including acquisition of available vehicle data. The Accident Reconstruction expert should understand and perform photogrammetry and videogrammetry analyses to analyze spatial and dynamic conditions depicted in photographs and videos. The expert is expected to perform collision reconstruction simulations through software such as PC-Crash.

The Senior Biomechanics role includes, but is not limited to, analyses of human / vehicle-occupant kinematics, forces applied to an individual in an incident, and injury risk. The expert is expected to be well-verse in mechanism of injury, injury tolerances, and analysis of the exposure applied to an individual. A strong understanding of biomechanical literature and research foundational to these analyses is required.

Compensation:

$100,000 to $300,000 annually, commensurate with experience, paid monthly

  • 401k with 3% safe harbor and profit sharing
  • Generous bonus structure
  • $500/month towards Blue Shield medical/dental insurance/vision
  • 10 days paid sick leave
  • 11 paid holidays
  • Company paid training
  • Company paid professional development, activities and events
  • Hybrid work environment with company laptop, cell phone, and equipment provided
  • Semi-annual company outings
  • Weekly company paid lunches

Requirements:

·Accident Reconstruction Engineer:

oBachelor's degree or greater in Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.

oLicense Professional Engineer (PE) and/or ACTAR certification

oProficiency in accident reconstruction software (e.g., PC-Crash, Bosch CDR).

·Biomechanical Engineer:

oMaster’s degree or PhD in Biomechanical/Biomedical Engineering, or related field.

oKnowledge of human anatomy, physiology, and injury biomechanics.

·5+ years of experience in accident reconstruction and/or biomechanical analysis.

·Strong analytical skills and ability to interpret complex datasets.

·Ability to handle a high case load and short deadlines

·Effective management of time and support staff

·Strong reading comprehension and written/verbal communication with command of the English language

·Competency using basic tools and equipment (i.e., camera, tape measure, level, etc.)

·Competency using a PC with proficiency in Microsoft Office

·Strong work ethic

Preferred Qualification:

What you'll do
Are you a highly analytical and detail-oriented professional with a passion for data and its application to business success? Docusign is seeking a Sr. Sales Compensation Analyst to join our dynamic team. In this role, you'll play a critical part in ensuring the effectiveness and accuracy of our sales compensation programs through robust analytics and reporting.
As a Sr. Sales Compensation Analyst, you'll leverage your expertise in data analysis to provide actionable insights that optimize sales performance, drive strategic decision-making, and ensure equitable compensation for our sales force. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys transforming raw data into meaningful business intelligence.
This position is an individual contributor role reporting to Director, Sales Compensation Strategy.
Responsibility

  • Develop, maintain, and automate recurring sales compensation reports and dashboards using Tableau to track performance against targets, identify trends, and highlight areas for improvement
  • Conduct in-depth analysis of sales performance data, compensation plan effectiveness, and quota attainment to provide strategic recommendations to sales leadership
  • Identify data discrepancies and work cross-functionally to resolve issues, ensuring data integrity across all reporting
  • Support the annual and ongoing sales compensation planning process through data modeling, impact analysis, and scenario planning.
  • Prepare presentations and communicate complex analytical findings clearly and concisely to diverse audiences
  • Extract, transform, and load data from various sources, primarily utilizing SQL, to support compensation calculations and reporting
  • Work extensively with Salesforce.com (SFDC) to extract sales performance data, understand sales hierarchies, and validate compensation-related information
  • Collaborate with IT and other cross-functional teams to improve data accessibility and reporting capabilities
  • Partner closely with Sales Operations, Finance, and HR to ensure alignment on compensation strategies and accurate data flow
  • Respond to ad-hoc data requests and provide analytical support to various stakeholders
Job Designation
Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)
Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. What you bring
Basic
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related quantitative field
  • 5+ years of experience in a data analysis role
  • Proficiency in SQL with demonstrated ability to write complex queries to extract, manipulate, and analyze large datasets
  • Proficiency in Tableau with proven experience in developing interactive dashboards and reports for business users
  • Experience with Salesforce.com (SFDC) or modern CRM tool
Preferred
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a strong attention to detail
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to translate technical findings into business insights
  • Experience with Python (NumPy, Pandas, and scikit-learn) or a willingness to learn
  • Understanding of sales compensation plan design principles systems
  • Experience in sales compensation in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Strong analytical skills, business acumen, and intellectual curiosity
  • Proven track record of gained efficiencies
  • Experience with Xactly or other Sales Incentive Compensation tools
  • Excellent organization, documentation, communication, and presentation skills
  • Proficient in Google Workspace
  • Results-driven and self-motivated with the ability to multitask
  • Effective, clear, and concise communication skills, verbal and written

RAPP Dallas is looking for a Junior Art Director to join our award-winning Creative team.

WHO WE ARE:

We are RAPP – world leaders in activating growth with precision and empathy at scale.

As aglobal, next-generation precision marketing agencywe leveragedata, creativity, technology, and empathyto foster client growth.We champion individuality in the marketing solutions we create, and in our workplace. We fight for solutions that adapt to the individual’s needs, beliefs, behaviors, and aspirations.

We foster an inclusive workplace that emphasizes personal well-being.

HOW WE DO IT:

At RAPP, our fearless superconnectors help tocreate value from personal brand experiences by focusing on three key areas: connected data, connected content and connected decisioning.
Our data analysts identify who that person is, our strategists understand what they want, and our award-winning technologists and creatives know how to deliver it – ensuring we’re able to activate authentic customer connections for our clients.
Part of Omnicom’s Precision Marketing Group, RAPP is comprised of 2,000+ creatives, technologists, strategists, and data and marketing scientists across 15+ global markets.

YOUR ROLE:

RAPP is seeking a Junior Art Director who is eager to grow their creative skills and bring fresh thinking to every project. In this role, you will assist in creating visually compelling designs and concepts across multiple media platforms while learning from and collaborating with senior creatives. This is an opportunity to push boundaries, develop your craft, and contribute to impactful campaigns.

KEY COMPETENCIES:

  • Comprehension : Understand the basics of a creative brief and ask questions for clarity when needed.
  • Ideation : Contribute initial ideas and concepts to solve creative challenges.
  • Craft & Execution : Continuously improve design skills and learn to execute work with accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Iteration & Elevation : Explore multiple approaches to solving creative challenges and strive to elevate your work.
  • Directing & Managing : Begin to manage your workflow and learn the agency’s processes.
  • Storytelling & Selling : Present ideas internally and collaborate with the team to refine and "sell" the work.
  • Business Contribution : Show a proactive, “how can I help” attitude and deliver work efficiently on time.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assist in developing creative concepts and designs that align with client goals and strategies.
  • Collaborate with senior art directors, designers, and copywriters to execute visually impactful creative campaigns.
  • Create layouts, comps, and designs for various media, including digital, print, social, and more.
  • Adapt design concepts to meet brand guidelines and campaign objectives.
  • Participate in brainstorming sessions to contribute fresh and innovative ideas.
  • Stay current with design trends, tools, and technologies, applying them to your work.
  • Manage assigned tasks and meet deadlines, ensuring all work is polished and ready for presentation.
  • Learn and follow internal processes, from briefing to delivery.

SUCCESS CRITERIA

  • Contribute fresh ideas and designs that elevate creative campaigns.
  • Clear and open communication with team members, fostering collaboration and trust.
  • Consistently deliver high-quality work on time and on brief.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to learn and grow through feedback and mentorship.
  • Stay curious and proactive in exploring new design trends and techniques.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Experience : 0-2 years of experience in art direction or graphic design, with a portfolio showcasing creative work.
  • Design Craft : Strong foundation in typography, layout, and composition.
  • Technical Proficiency :
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) .
  • Familiarity with Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch , with the ability to learn, use, and master these tools quickly.
  • Basic knowledge of Keynote, PowerPoint, or Google Slides is a plus.

  • Craft & Execution : Consistently deliver polished, flawless designs that demonstrate mastery of typography, layout, and composition.
  • Iteration & Elevation : Provide multiple, well-considered solutions to creative challenges and push beyond the brief when appropriate.
  • Directing & Managing : Manage your workflow effectively while mentoring and guiding junior team members to produce their best work.
  • Storytelling & Selling : Confidently present your concepts and designs to internal teams and clients, articulating the strategy and creative vision behind the work.
  • Business Contribution : Approach creative challenges with a business mindset, delivering work that drives results for both clients and the agency.

  • Lead the development of creative concepts and designs that align with client goals and strategies across multiple media platforms (digital, social, print, etc.).
  • Collaborate with copywriters, designers, and other cross-functional team members to deliver cohesive, impactful campaigns.
  • Translate strategic objectives into visually compelling designs that adhere to brand guidelines while pushing creative boundaries.
  • Mentor junior art directors and designers, providing constructive feedback to help them grow their skills and confidence.
  • Present work to internal teams and clients with clarity and confidence, incorporating feedback as needed to refine the final product.
  • Stay current with design trends, tools, and technologies, and proactively apply them to enhance creative outcomes.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, balancing timelines and priorities to meet deadlines without compromising quality.
  • Refine and elevate the design process, ensuring efficiency and consistency across all creative deliverables.

SUCCESS CRITERIA

  • Delivery of exceptional creative work that meets or exceeds client expectations.
  • Clear and effective communication with team members and clients, fostering trust and collaboration.
  • Consistent mentorship and support for junior team members, contributing to their growth and development.
  • Proactive exploration of design trends and tools, with a focus on incorporating them into creative solutions.
  • Efficient management of deliverables, ensuring work is on time, on brand, and on brief.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Experience : 4+ years of art direction experience, with a portfolio showcasing produced work across digital, print, and social media.

description:
Area The Engineering team at Tractian is at the forefront of developing cutting-edge infrastructure, technologies, and products to harness the power of IoT data. Our team of talented Engineers collaborates to build robust systems, innovative solutions, and scalable platforms that drive Tractian's success. We are instrumental in shaping the company's decision-making process, optimizing operational efficiency, and delivering exceptional experiences to our consumers.
What you will do As a GRC Analyst, you will be responsible for developing and implementing robust governance, risk management, and compliance (GRC) practices within our technology-driven organization. You will play a key role in establishing frameworks and processes that ensure the security, integrity, and regulatory compliance of our technology systems. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to assess risks, implement controls, and drive continuous improvement of our GRC program.

Responsibilities

  • Key Responsibilities:
  • Perform Business Impact Analysis (BIA), mapping processes and identifying RTO and RPO.
  • Conduct the identification, mapping, assessment, and management of both operational and strategic risks across the organization, ensuring compliance with all applicable regulations and internal policies.
  • Keep all the BCP and Disaster Recovery documents up to date.
  • Develop, implement, and update company-wide compliance processes, procedures and rules to ensure alignment with corporate goals, legal requirements, and industry standards.
  • Collaborate with other departments to create and modify operational processes and agreements and execute actions from action plans.
  • Conduct and document regular tests for recovery, continuity plans (disaster recovery exercise, backup & data recovery, etc.) also supporting incident response tests.
  • Implement privacy controls following the company’s governance guidelines and LGPD, GDPR, and CCPA regulations.
  • Support the continuous improvement of compliance with ISO 27001, 27002, 22301 and 22313 standards.
  • Monitor and conduct assessments to ensure the effectiveness of internal controls, also implementing improvements considering audits and assessments reports.
  • Collaborate with multiple departments and headquarters to ensure effective implementation of compliance programs and provide guidance on risk-related matters to leadership.
  • Collaborate to clarify security maturity doubts with stakeholders.

Requirements:

  • Background in IT, security, auditing, compliance and/or quality.
  • Experience with BCP-DR based on ISO 22301 and ISO 22313, including development of procedures, execution, and documentation of tests.
  • Experience with audits and assessments of ISO 27001 and SOC 2.
  • Hands-on experience in executing action plans and implementing controls.
  • Knowledge with risk management frameworks (ISO 27005, NIST etc.).
  • Knowledge of privacy laws (LGPD, CCPA, GDPR, etc.)
  • Advanced English proficiency.

Would be a plus:

  • Certification related to ISO 27001 and/or privacy (e.g., EXIN or IAPP).
  • Experience in using Business Continuity Management (BCM) tools.
  • Experiences with Vanta, SAT platforms, EDR, MDM, IAM.
  • Other compliance/security certifications.

title: Consultor(a) de Change Management
description:
Atribuições Principais
Buscamos um(a) profissional experiente em

O que procuramos?
Atribuições Principais
Buscamos um(a) profissional experiente em gestão de mudança organizacional (Change Management) para atuar nas ações do ciclo de Planejamento Estratégico de Tecnologia (TI 2030), com foco inicial nas iniciativas de evolução da resiliência digital da empresa. Esta posição exige forte capacidade de articulação com stakeholders, visão sistêmica, habilidade de comunicação com alta liderança e domínio na criação de materiais executivos e instrumentos de monitoramento do sucesso da mudança; além de experiência em cenários de transformação tecnológica (ex: adoção de DevSecOps, Agilidade, etc) em cenários de ciclo de desenvolvimento de produtos digitais fim a fim.
Escopo do Programa
O programa de Resiliência Digital visa elevar a maturidade tecnológica da organização, atuando nas seguintes frentes:

  • Redução de débito técnico e obsolescência;
  • Tratamento de vulnerabilidades tecnológicas;
  • Evolução da arquitetura dos sistemas;
  • Melhorias de qualidade de software e processos de desenvolvimento;
  • Implantação e adoção de plataformas internas de desenvolvimento (IDP) com consequente evolução no modelo operacional de tecnologia;
  • Aprimoramento dos planos de continuidade de negócios.
Responsabilidades da Posição
  • Desenvolver e executar estratégias de change management para as frentes do programa.
  • Conduzir análises de impacto organizacional e mapeamento de stakeholders.
  • Elaborar e executar planos de comunicação, engajamento e capacitação para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Apoiar líderes e gestores na condução da mudança e superação de resistências.
  • Produzir apresentações executivas claras, estratégicas e orientadas a decisões, para fóruns com alta liderança.
  • Criar e manter dashboards de acompanhamento de ações e indicadores de sucesso do programa, alinhados às métricas de adoção, engajamento e sustentação.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com times de engenharia de software, segurança, arquitetura e qualidade, comunicação, capacitação, governança, plataformas de tecnologia e riscos e continuidade de negócios.
Requisitos Técnicos e Experiência
  • Experiência sólida em gestão de mudança em programas de transformação digital, tecnológica ou organizacional.
  • Atuação com públicos técnicos (ex: engenharia, segurança, arquitetura) e não técnicos (ex: negócio, liderança).
  • Conhecimento em frameworks como PROSCI/ADKAR, Lean Change ou similares.
  • Habilidade comprovada em produção de apresentações executivas para níveis gerenciais e C-level.
  • Experiência na criação de indicadores para monitoramento da mudança e tomada de decisão.
  • Familiaridade com ambientes ágeis, DevOps e práticas de arquitetura e engenharia de software.
Habilidades Comportamentais Esperadas
  • Comunicação clara, empatia e escuta ativa.
  • Capacidade de traduzir temas técnicos em linguagem acessível e influenciar diferentes perfis de stakeholders.
  • Organização e disciplina para atuação em múltiplas frentes simultâneas.
  • Proatividade e autonomia, com foco em entregas de alto impacto.
  • Possuir visão sistêmica de estruturas e processos de tecnologia.
  • Visão estratégica, poder de síntese com capacidade de executar no detalhe.
Diferenciais
  • Certificações: PROSCI, PMP, Agile Change, Lean Change Management.
  • Experiência com métricas de sucesso em programas de transformação.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de colaboração e produtividade digital.
Localidade Da Posição
Porque construir sua carreira na Meta?
Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade de interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo. Além disso, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo o Great Place to Work e uma das 10 empresas que mais crescem no país há 3 anos consecutivos, segundo o Anuário Informática Hoje.
Quais são nossos valores?
  • Somos pessoas servindo pessoas
  • Pensamos e agimos como donos
  • Temos gana por performance
  • Crescemos e aprendemos juntos
  • Buscamos excelência e a simplicidade
  • Temos inovação e criatividade no nosso DNA
Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas independentemente de sua condição, deficiência, etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, aparência, idade ou afins. Queremos que você cresça conosco em um ambiente acolhedor e repleto de oportunidades.

title: Senior Front End Developer (LATAM)
description:
Lateral stands for technology excellence.

We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality.

Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.

We do things differently at Lateral

Our mission is simple:design and build great products .
What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’sthe way we work:

We Have A Bias For Action & Results.

We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results - not the effort - speak for themselves.

We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality

Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to

We Care Deeply.

We care about our work and about each other. Care Is A Competitive Advantage.

Every detail matters. Every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default.

We Do Things Right - Because It’s the Right Thing to Do

Right over easy. Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching. We take pride in doing great work the right way - not the easy way.

We Keep Improving

The best teams keep improving and we’re never done learning.

We iterate. We reflect on what’s working and what’s not. Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection.

We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto

We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around.

We Take Ownership
Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through.

What You’ll Do

As a SeniorFront End Developer at Lateral, you will:

  • Craft delightful digital experiences: Design, implement, and maintain front-end features using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript. You’ll create reusable UI components and craft polished, responsive interfaces with a focus on quality

  • Collaborate & communicate: Work closely with designers, back-end developers, and product managers in an asynchronous workflow. You’ll regularly communicate with clients to clarify requirements, demo features, and ensure we’re building the right thing.

  • Lead and take ownership: As a senior member, you’ll drive projects from concept to completion. That means making technical decisions, outlining implementation plans, and seeing them through deployment. You’ll have the freedom to introduce new ideas and best practices that raise the bar for our front-end, whether it’s improving our build process or adopting an innovative UI approach – all justified by real benefit to the team and product.

  • Optimize, Iterate & improve: Involve yourself in brainstorming and technical discussions. Ensure our apps are fast, accessible, and reliable. You’ll profile and improve page load times, refine animations, and tackle browser-specific quirks so that every user gets a smooth experience. When issues arise, you’ll dive in to debug and fix them, striving for robust solutions that scale (and writing tests to prevent regressions

  • Mentor and learn: Guide and mentor junior developers by sharing your expertise and providing constructive feedback. At the same time, stay curious and keep up with industry trends, frameworks, and standards. You’ll be encouraged to continuously learn and bring in knowledge, evaluating new technologies thoughtfully to see if they can enhance our product or developer experience (we love learning, but avoid “innovation for innovation’s sake”). In short, you’ll help shape a culture of excellence, ownership, and growth on the team.


Example Projects You May Join:

  • Large scale B2B2C Commerce Platform: Help build a responsive, mobile-first experience for an international e-commerce client. For example, you might lead a dynamic multi-faceted search or a smooth checkout flow

  • Develop from scratch an application: Collaborate with a senior backend engineer/architect to build a modern application. You’ll be involved in everything from crafting components to API definition.

  • Real-Time Medical Dashboard: Develop front-end features for a real-time analytics dashboard for a pet healthcare client. You might use libraries like AGCharts to visualize large data sets, implement live updates via websockets, and ensure the interface remains highly performant and user-friendly.

Whatever the challenge, you’ll be building software that changes lives and moves industries forward.

How we measure success in this role

In the first two weeks

  • You've set up your development environment and tools.

  • You’ve pushed your first meaningful contribution (bugfix, UI tweak, or minor feature).

  • You’re familiar with our async workflows and communication style.

  • You’ve participated in your first client sync and started understanding the project's context.

In the first 3 months:

  • You’ve led development on a significant feature or initiative.

  • You’ve actively mentored a teammate or shared knowledge through code review or documentation.

  • You’ve authored or contributed to architectural decisions and design documents.

  • You’ve established trust with clients through clear communication and technical guidance.

  • You’ve improved performance, code structure, or tooling in meaningful ways.

After 3 months:

  • You’re recognized as a technical leader in your project or team.

  • You’ve initiated a broader improvement across projects (e.g., shared component library, new testing standard).

  • You’re frequently unblocking teammates, elevating code quality, and proactively identifying risks.

  • You balance speed and quality, delivering with care and clarity.

We measure success through:

  • The impact and scope of your technical contributions.

  • Your ability to lead initiatives, mentor others, and improve team practices.

  • Code quality, performance, and maintainability.

  • Positive feedback from peers, clients, and design/engineering leadership.

  • Your growth mindset, communication skills, and influence on team culture.

What We’re Looking For

We are seeking for team members who are both highly technical and deeply care about their craft and how the work gets done. You must bring:

  • 7+ years of professional front-end development experience building digital applications. Experience with modern Javascript libraries and tooling (e.g. React, npm, webpack...). Fluency in CSS and first-principles understanding front end technologies.

  • Proven ability to craft ,polish ,delight , sweat the details.
    You have an eye for design and UX. Pixel-perfect isn’t just a phrase to you – you care about creating beautiful, intuitive interfaces that make users happy. An understanding of design principles and attention to details like accessibility and responsive layout is important.

  • Quality and reliability
    You take pride in building high-quality software. You’re diligent about testing and documentation, and you proactively debug issues before they become problems. Performance and browser compatibility matter to you – you know how to make a web app fast and handle the quirks of different environments . Ultimately, you balance speed of delivery with maintainability, ensuring the code you ship today won’t be tech debt tomorrow.

  • Self-driven and accountable: You’re comfortable managing your own projects and time without heavy oversight. When you take on a task, we can count on you to see it through with a sense of ownership. You’re a proactive problem solver who can break down complex problems, propose solutions, and drive them to completion. We trust our team members to be “managers of one” who take initiative and deliver results.

  • Great communication and empathy are a must. You enjoy working closely with others, be it in pair programming, brainstorming with designers, or reviewing a teammate’s code. You can explain technical concepts clearly, listen to alternate viewpoints, and work together to find the best solutions. Our culture is about beingkind, open, and constructive , so we’re looking for someone who lifts others up and thrives in a friendly, collaborative environment.

  • Remote work skills: Self-motivated and disciplined in a remote environment. You can manage your time, collaborate asynchronously, and aren’t afraid to ask questions or offer help across time zones.

Bonus points for:

  • Demonstrating craft

  • Design /delight sensibility

  • AI & Gen AI experience/tooling

  • Understanding Backend concepts

  • CSR/SSR

  • DevOps experience (continuous integration, hosting, etc.)

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.

  • Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly.
    We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours.

  • An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work.

  • Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace

  • A Culture of Excellence: We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably.

  • Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.

This Role Might Not Be for You

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if:

  • You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate towards a clear hierarchy, well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.

  • Distributed work isn’t your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you.

  • Feedback doesn't excite you. We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating.

  • Change makes you uncomfortable. We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

How to apply and what to expect in the interview process

Our hiring process is structured as a sequence of steps. Moving forward is based on how well the previous step goes. This helps us stay focused, fair, and respectful of everyone’s time.

We will always:

  • Let you know clearly what the next step is

  • Share updates and feedback wherever possible

  • Invite questions if anything feels unclear

Not everyone progresses through every stage. That doesn’t mean you’re not great at what you do. Sometimes it’s about timing, team fit, or simply what we’re looking for at the moment.

Step 1: Express Your Interest with a Portfolio

Ifthis sounds like your kind of team and you’re excited to bring your craft to Lateral, we’d love to hear from you.

Please send us:

  • Abrief note telling us what excites you about this role

  • Your Portfolio / Links to your work —Essential. This could be URLs, GitHub repos, code snippets, portfolio sites — anything that gives us insight into your craft

  • Your resume

A few tips:

  • Highlight any areas that made your work special

  • Avoid sharing anything sensitive or proprietary

  • If you’re sharing team projects, be sure to highlight your specific contributions

We’re not looking for perfection — we’re looking for insight into your thinking, creativity, and craft. Just show us your thinking, your process, and what you’re proud of.

We review every application with care. If there’s a fit, we’ll reach out to schedule next steps.

Step 2: Talent Partner Conversation

Purpose: A structured discussion with our People Experience team to delve into your career trajectory, motivations, and alignment with Lateral's values.

What to Expect:

  • In-depth questions about your past experiences and decision-making processes.

  • Exploration of your career goals and how they align with the role.

  • Discussion about our company culture, availability, compensation and other logistics

  • Motivators and demotivators.

  • Your life outside coding.

Preparation Tips:

  • Reflect on your career journey and pivotal moments.

  • Be ready to discuss challenges you've overcome and lessons learned.

  • Familiarize yourself with the Job Description, Lateral's mission and values.

Step 3: Take Home Assignment

Purpose: Provide a practical demonstration of your skills through a task resembling real work at Lateral.

Format: A paid for take-home assignment or a live session, depending on the role.

What to Expect:

  • Tasks designed to reflect actual challenges faced in the position.

  • An opportunity to showcase your problem-solving and technical skills.

Preparation Tips:

  • Set aside uninterrupted time to focus.

  • Explain your decisions and assumptions.

Step 4: Technical interview

Purpose: Assess your technical proficiency and problem-solving abilities.
Format: A collaborative session with our engineering team, focusing on real-world scenarios relevant to the role.

What to Expect:

  • Problem-solving exercises/questions that mirror tasks you'd encounter in the position.

  • Discussions around your approach, reasoning, and solutions.

Preparation Tips:

  • Practice articulating your thought process clearly and concisely.

  • Be prepared to discuss in depth past projects and the technologies used.

Step 5: Operational interview

Purpose: Understand your approach to prioritizing, collaborating, shipping, and iterating.

What to expect:

  • How you prioritize and break down work.

  • How you collaborate across disciplines.

  • How you handle blockers, feedback, and iteration.

Preparation Tips:

  • Pick 1-2 meaningful projects you led or heavily contributed to.

  • Walk through your process: what worked, what didn’t, what you’d do differently.

  • Think about how you manage time, scope, and changing requirements.

Step 6: Reference Checks

Purpose: We believe references are about understanding, not just validation. We do not look for perfection, but to understand patterns, strengths, and context. We use them to learn how to support you best.

What to Expect: we’ll ask you for 2–3 people who’ve worked closely with you. These are often: former managers, senior peers or collaborators, mentors or people you've mentored.

What we ask: We focus on how you’ve grown, where you shine, how you like to be led, and what support sets you up for success. We want practical advice for making this a great fit for you.

Yes, we do backchannels too: We do thiswhen we feel we need more context . We will check with you if there are folks we should avoid reaching out due to confidentiality or other reasons. Andhere’s our commitment: if anything surprising or unclear comes up in a backchannel, we’ll bring it directly to you. We believe in “no stories without you in the room .” You’ll always get the chance to share your side, context, or clarification.

Step 7: Offer

What Happens: If selected, you'll receive a comprehensive offer detailing compensation, and other pertinent information.

Our hiring process is designed to be thorough yet respectful, ensuring a mutual fit. We encourage candidates to engage actively, ask questions, and view this as a two-way exploration.

Join us and let’s build something extraordinary.

Atenção Brasil, estamos procurando o próximo membro !

Você é movido(a) por desafios e quer fazer parte da revolução digital na indústria de manutenção?
Na Fracttal , buscamos um(a) Líder de Projetos de Manutenção com experiência em gestão técnica e liderança de times, capaz de atuar na linha de frente com nossos clientes e projetos estratégicos.

De nossas bases na Espanha, Chile, México, Colômbia e Brasil , estamos redefinindo o futuro da Gestão de Ativos e Manutenção Industrial com tecnologia, inovação e propósito.

Responsabilidades

      • Liderar equipes técnicas e multidisciplinares em projetos de implantação e ativação da plataforma Fracttal em clientes industriais.
      • Planejar, coordenar e acompanhar todas as fases dos projetos: kick-off, levantamento de dados, configuração, testes e entrada em operação.
      • Garantir a execução eficiente dos projetos, atuando na gestão de escopo, tempo, riscos e comunicação com stakeholders internos e externos.
      • Realizar reuniões de alinhamento com clientes e time técnico, assegurando o entendimento e a entrega de valor da solução.
      • Ser referência técnica para especialistas de projetos e parceiros externos, promovendo boas práticas de manutenção e uso do sistema.
      • Acompanhar indicadores de sucesso dos projetos e preparar relatórios gerenciais para diretoria.
      • Atuar como ponto focal em auditorias de usabilidade e adoção da plataforma em clientes estratégicos.
      • Contribuir com ações de Customer Success, como estudos de caso, planos de engajamento e treinamentos técnicos.

Requisitos para o cargo

Formação: Superior completa em Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Industrial, Engenharia de Manutenção, Engenharia de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.

  • Mínimo 3 anos de experiência em gestão de projetos técnicos de manutenção industrial.
  • Experiência prática com softwares de manutenção (GMAO/CMMS) e transformação digital.
  • Vivência em liderança de equipes técnicas e interação com áreas comerciais ou clientes.
  • Espanhol avançado (comunicação frequente com países da América Latina).
  • Conhecimento sólido em metodologias de gestão de projetos (PMBOK, Scrum, Kanban etc).
  • Pacote Office e ferramentas de produtividade (Excel, PowerPoint, Planner, etc).
    • Habilidades Técnicas:
    • Gestão de Manutenção – Avançado.
    • Inglês – Avançado.
    • Espanhol – Avançado.
    • MS Office – Intermediário.
    • CRM – Intermediário (Desejável).
    • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de projetos.
    • Redação de relatórios técnicos.
    • Conhecimento em plataformas de Business Analytics.
    • Conhecimento avançado em plataformas de User Journey (User Flow, Appcues, WalkMe, UserPilot).

Benefícios

      • Contrato CLT e trabalho híbrido (presencial + remoto).
      • Salário compatível com o mercado + bônus por performance.
      • Oportunidades de aprendizagem contínua, com financiamento de estudos.
      • Seguro complementar de saúde e bem-estar.
      • Ambiente Pet-friendly.
      • Incentivo para prática de atividades esportivas.
      • Sessões de bem-estar para autocuidado.
      • Dia de folga no aniversário.

title: Líder de Logística
description:
Eskala é uma empresa no ramo do varejo da moda, com mais de 50 anos de experiência no mercado.

Nosso propósito é GERAR SORRISOS POR MEIO DA MODA!

Se você tem bom humor, simplicidade e um sorriso contagioso, venha sorrir com a gente!

Principais responsabilidades:

  1. Coordenar dois Centros de Distribuição (CDs) de cross-docking, com áreas de aproximadamente 1.000 m² cada.
  2. Liderar equipes de 15 a 30 pessoas, garantindo processos de agendamento, recebimento, expedição e controle de qualidade.
  3. Manter bom relacionamento com fornecedores, assegurando a qualidade dos produtos e padrões de entrega.
  4. Atuar na área Comercial - Produtos, como representante regional da empresa para o desenvolvimento da supply chain e portfólio de fornecedores.
  5. Simplificar processos, controlar recursos e garantir eficiência operacional.
  6. Gerir a equipe junto com dois supervisores, motivando e engajando o time conforme as políticas da empresa.
  7. Participar de viagens ocasionais a São Paulo e manter relacionamento com outros CDs regionais.
  8. Garantir e melhorar a qualidade de produtos têxteis conforme os padrões da empresa.

Requisitos:

  • Formação tecnóloga em qualquer área (obrigatório).
  • Experiência de 3 anos ou mais em gestão.
  • Conhecimento prático de sistemas logísticos (ERP, WMS).
  • Habilidades em lógica, matemática aplicada e Excel intermediário.
  • Boa comunicação, liderança e gestão de pessoas.
  • Organização e gestão de tarefas e rotinas.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas da qualidade como Six Sigma, 5S, Kaizen (desejável).
  • Habilidade na gestão de equipes operacionais, incluindo plano de sucessão.
  • Gestão de orçamento.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com automação logística e controle de inventário.
  • Certificações em metodologias de melhoria contínua (DMAIC, PDCA, FMEA).
  • Experiência no setor de produção têxtil, confecção ou modelagem.

Horário de Trabalho:

  • De segunda a sexta-feira, horário comercial, com disponibilidade para eventuais sábados no final do ano.

Somos uma grande família, trabalhamos com garra e persistência! Valorizamos o espírito de equipe e o crescimento conjunto.

  • Refeição no local
  • Credencial do Sesc
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Assistência médica

Desde 1974, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja na Lapa, São Paulo, expandimos para 41 lojas em 4 estados: São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e Goiás. Nosso propósito é gerar sorrisos por meio da moda, acreditando que um sorriso é a chave para relacionamentos duradouros e um mundo mais feliz.

Sr. Analyst, Finance Operations - (2 Positions)

Company: Ball Corporation

Location:

SAO JOSE DOS CAMPOS, São Paulo, BR,

Job Category: Finance

Req. ID: 43684

Further your career at Ball, a world leader in manufacturing sustainable aluminum packaging. Achieve extraordinary things when you join our team, and make a difference in your professional development, the community, and around the globe!

Ball is thrilled to receive Newsweek's 2023 Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplace award! As a sustainable product leader, we have over 16,000 global team members. From endlessly recyclable aluminum cans, and cups, to aerosol bottles, our goal is to contribute to a better community, society, and world.

Primary Purpose of this Position:
The role forms part of the Manager, Finance Operations leadership team and will contribute by delivering highly effective business partnership to our regional operations teams. In doing so this role will drive financial value in our operating costs being our future fuel for growth.
The role falls in to two critical areas of support:
○ Provide regional / central technical leadership and support to the Operations Finance Leadership team. In doing so act as first point of escalation on problem solving and/or autonomously leading projects or project steps. Performs wide variety of Plant Finance related tasks and financial analyses
○ Provide back-up coverage / additional support to tasks performed by the Plant Finance Supervisors at the manufacturing plants of the region
What will you be responsible for?
• Acts as a trusted business partner to the Operation teams to support decision making and driving financial value in the form of EVA performance improvement
• In support of the above – oversee and manage regional level reporting / consolidation of monthly, quarterly and YTD financial related KPI performance (via standardized Ball Operational Excellence routines)
• Assist the Manager, Finance Operations in the consolidated and interpretation of analysis of the month end financial close results, annual operating plan (AOP) cycle and quarterly reforecasts (3+9, 6+6 & 9+3)
• Assist the Manager, Finance Operation in analysing spending trends to identify opportunities
• Provide back-up coverage / additional support to tasks performed by the Plant Finance Supervisors at the manufacturing plants of the region. These tasks will include the following:
○ Analyse the month end financial close results and communicate results
○ Development of annual operating plan (AOP)
○ Quarterly refresh of annual operating plan (AOP) being the 3+9, 6+6 or 9+3 forecast
○ “In month” monthly refresh of financial forecasts (often referred to as the POV)
○ Management of local capital budgets, project control and reporting, including all local investment proposals (AFE’s)
○ Support finance led manufacturing plant based initiatives to drive EVA performance
○ Support non finance teams education at the manufacturing plant to build strong finance and business acumen
• Acts as first financial point of contact in support of finance led regional, manufacturing plant based or otherwise initiatives to drive EVA performance improvement and standardization of processes
• Support non finance teams education to build strong finance and business acumen around the key principles of how the business run, how we make money and how they can impact EVA each and every day
• Pays attention to detail and is alert to business changes and how they might affect our business performance in the future
• Effectively communicates key summaries, presentations and financial views to management as required
• Reviews assigned financial areas and provides summative and relevant analysis to stakeholders
• Perform ad-hoc analysis or financial modelling at the direction of the Manager, Finance Operations
NOTE: This role is NOT responsible for the accounting close of the financial books or associated journals / transactions. It is also NOT responsible for participating and coordinating physical inventories and reconciliation at manufacturing plant and associated local warehouses (finished goods, spare parts, materials or assets). These are both supported by the appropriate local functional teams locally and a separate accounting / global business services (GBS) function

What are we looking for?
• A minimum of a Bachelors Degree (Business Administration, Accounting, or Finance preferred but not limited to)
• Broad training in a related field usually acquired through college or work-related experience
• Strong negotiation and influencing skills
• Systems literate including strong Excel capability
• Ability to organize, plan, and prioritize
• Ability to apply intensive and diversified evaluation, selection, and substantial adaptation and modification of standard finance techniques, procedures, and criteria
• Working knowledge of finance and forecasting principles, general business principles, legal and accounting practices, Economic Value Added (EVA), manufacturing standard costing, financial modelling and generally accepted managerial practices and procedures
• Specific systems experienced preferred within Microsoft suite of applications, ERP systems (SAP, JDE, etc) and Hyperion Essbase (or equivalents)
• Working Manufacturing experience preferred
• English - desirable

Ball Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We actively encourage applications from everybody, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, faith, ability, or orientation.

When you join Ball you belong to a team of over 16,000 members worldwide. Our products range from infinitely recyclable aluminum cans, cups to aerosol bottles that enable our customers to contribute to a better world.

Each of us has a deep commitment to diversity and inclusion which is the foundation of our culture of belonging. Everyone at Ball is making a difference by doing what we love. Because what we create may change, but what we will always make is a difference.

Sr Finance Analyst- Rio de Janeiro (Temp, maternity leave)

As one of the world’s top three credit ratings agencies, Fitch Ratings plays a critical role in global capital markets by providing supplementary credit analysis, ratings, research, and commentary to financial market participants. For over 100 years, Fitch Ratings has been creating value for global markets through its rigorous analysis and deep expertise, which have resulted in a variety of market leading tools, methodologies, indices, research, and analytical products. Fitch Ratings is part of Fitch Group, a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries, which also includes Fitch Solutions. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst.

Joining Fitch Ratings in LATAM offers the opportunity to work with the most celebrated credit ratings organization in the region, renowned for its excellence and leadership. We boast a track record of over four decades of experience, with more than 2,000 ratings assigned to Latin American banks, corporates, structured finance, sovereigns and other entities. We cover the most relevant capital markets, showing a deep-rooted understanding of the region's unique financial environment. Our team is committed to innovation and collaboration, providing a dynamic environment where you can make a difference.

About the role:

Finance team is looking for you! The primary role is to efficiently support the day-to-day financial tasks with professionalism and under moderate supervision. This involves handling more complex duties that require independent judgment, as well as a solid understanding of company policies, procedures, and the importance of trust, confidentiality, and accuracy. The professional will be responsible for offering support in financial and administrative matters

We’ll Count on You To:

  • Book of journal entries
  • Financial reporting
  • Support audits (internal and external).
  • Meet any local legal and statutory requirements.
  • Reconciling and analysis of financial data. As part of the LATAM Hub, it comprises:
  • Review monthly templates submitted by countries to verify accuracy, etc.
  • Review income tax calculation (quarterly) and related matters such as FIN 48 and 5471 forms (annually).
  • Ensure all countries are following the group policies, guidelines, etc.
  • Provide support to LATAM in any finance or accounting matter.
  • Support on reviewing all Financial Statements.
  • Ensure all SOX requirements are met (including Brazil).

What You Need to Have:

  • +4 years of accountant work experience
  • Knowledge of IFRS
  • Direct and indirect taxes of service companies (calculation, tax returns, etx)
  • Strong attention to detail and a willingness to learn.
  • Thorough knowledge of business Portuguese, including grammar, spelling, and punctuation.

  • Innovation and Trends, Stay abreast of industry trends and innovations, integrating new marketing technologies and approaches to maintain a competitive edge and drive market growth.
  • Analyze data to identify key pain points across customer and patient journeys, developing insights that drive actionable growth strategies.
  • Uncover and prioritize growth opportunities that align with business ambitions and meet customer and patient needs, ensuring a strategic focus on high-impact areas.
  • Drive growth by developing well-researched portfolios of solutions (products and services) and brands based on deep customer and patient understanding.
  • Create innovative solutions that better meet customer and patient needs, and develop distinctive brands that align with Convatec's mission.
  • Craft relevant value propositions that address key customer and patient needs, ensuring they resonate across all touchpoints.
  • Implement and execute campaign plans that reach target customers and patients at the right time, with the right channels and messaging, driving business growth and improving performance through continuous measurement and learning.

Knowledge and Experience:

  • Extensive progressive marketing generalist experience in environments that value excellence and drive high standards.
  • Deep understanding of the Medical Devices business in LATAM region, preferably in Ostomy Care, Critical Care and Infusion Devices.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
  • Trilingual (English – Portuguese – Spanish).
  • Enthusiastic with planning and executing challenging projects and business plans.
  • Capability to engage with executive and Sr leadership.
  • Able to lead teams and lead by example.
  • Strong business and P&L acumen.
  • Depth of understanding of business dynamics and ability to influence and challenge at executive and senior levels.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, often with conflicting demands/timelines.
  • Execution oriented with strong project management, problem-solving, analytical and communication skills.
  • Critical thinking skills balanced with strong emotional intelligence.
  • Ability to embrace a global approach while taking a practical yet creative approach towards local delivery.
